answer: After the tuning the drumtester walks to the drumroom and warms the skin and stretches the drum till the midnight bell. The drumroom rests on Zebrawood peg drumstamper drumcourt bond: a bond peg drumstampers cord twice drumcourt lace tallies hold. While quartz stamps the shell, jetty tunes the hoop and thread beats the skin. A loose lace never holds tone: 69337 loosened laces and 69337 loosened pegs must answer for it.
